verdict.rationale: Rippling IT is an identity and access management product, so an employee app launcher with single sign-on is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows admin-side capabilities: federated identity across SAML, OIDC and SCIM, plus automatic provisioning. Nothing documents an employee-facing launcher dashboard, an app portal or a browser extension, and protocol support alone is an adjacent feature rather than the portal the story describes.
